notes: Project: hearth-and-horizon (headline SF shelf). Piece: a-metre-apart, about 5,290 words, text only. All weekdays and Easter 2046 (25 Mar) checked in code. Verification: node --test in ventures/hearth-and-horizon 17/17 pass; check_post_frontmatter, check_post_links, post_similarity pass; run_workflow_locally --for-changes output summarized in the PR. certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
